title: Menko
tagline: Slam it. Flip it. Win the disc.
description: A children's floor game from Japan with real air-gust odds. Slam your paper disc beside a rival's, turn it face-down, and collect twenty-four original designs.
howToPlay: Pick a disc from your tray: heavy discs make a stronger gust.
Tap the floor to aim and drag to nudge; the dashed circle is where it may land.
Set the strength: harder slams scatter wider.
Press Slam: rival discs in reach show their chance to flip.
Land on top of a rival disc and yours is lost; most stars wins.
